text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The dirt heroes have assembled at Chukyo 
Racecourse! A chaotic battle is 
inevitable! Which Umamusume will claim 
supremacy over the dirt world?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Please wait just a little longer before 
the Champions Cup begins!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—Somehow, it reminds me of last year. 
Back then, I really didn't have any room 
to breathe.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...How should I put it, there's a sense 
of reassurance that wasn't there last 
year."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. I was reminded once again 
that you're always supporting me, so I'm 
sure—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ......I see. So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As a dirt Umamusume... as a local idol... 
as Hokko Tarumae... as the radiant star 
nurtured by Tomakomai—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will shine the brightest in this 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking like that, Hokko Tarumae seemed 
to radiate an undeniable presence of true 
majesty...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Still, please don't forget.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I am the star of Tomakomai. 
And at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That you are also the star who made me 
shine.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm off. —Time to give Rickey her baptism 
by fire!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
âRickeyâ Luckyâ Mega-auspicious~!! 
And what we're aiming for is~ a massive 
comeback~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't look like they'll let me off 
that easily. Standing here in person 
really is completely different, huh.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This feels even tougher than what they 
told me... I can't stop my legs from 
shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— Still, despite your words, you seem 
to be having fun, which is all that 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san! Looking forward to today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm. Let's give it everything we've got, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—To keep from being outshone by her 
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Tomakomai's shining star, Hokko Tarumae!! 
Today... I'm going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm here, Tarumae. Just as promised, all 
the way here.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ......I was waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll teach you. Just like how 
Acute-san and the others taught me last 
year.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...This is the front line of dirt racing. 
Its grandest stage. And—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That I'm the most dazzling one here 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, Tarumae-chan, you're starting 
to look a little like Falco-san...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Luckyâ Giant Upset!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose...! I've been building up for 
today as well, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's begin—our contest of radiance!!
